# Runtime Architecture — Truth Before Decoration

The Awtsmoos is beyond scheduler, network, and shell, yet each vessel must tell truth in time;
Awtsmoos.com lets immediate controls, canonical hydration, and completion state become separate lines that rhyme.

## Chosen architecture

### 1. Bound timing collaborators

`NetzachGeometryGate` will resolve native timing methods with their original runtime receiver. Injected test collaborators remain supported.

### 2. Immediate shell-control boot

Create `KeterReaderShellControlsBoot` as a small initialization vessel. It binds Typography/Commentary transient-surface routing as soon as the document body exists, before slow post loading or identity hydration. It is idempotent, preserves the existing `setupGlobalClicks()` and `toggleSidebar()` contracts, and marks `readerShellControlsReady` only after binding.

Later `setupUIListeners()` may safely call the same popover setup again because `MedaberPopoverGate` already prevents duplicate global listener attachment.

### 3. Truthful fatal propagation

`ignite()` may render the fatal reader placeholder, but fatal canonical bootstrap errors must be rethrown. `postLogic` alone owns the top-level boot failure state.

### 4. Explicit boot-state invariant

Create a small `TiferesReaderBootState` state vessel. Completion is legal only when `socialReaderReady === "true"`. Failure clears any completed marker and records the error message. This prevents future false-success regressions even if another inner module accidentally returns after a rupture.

## Compatibility laws

- Existing IDs remain unchanged.
- Existing `toggleSidebar`, `setupGlobalClicks`, `ignite`, and post boot entry remain callable.
- No HTML rewrite is necessary for this tranche.
- Shell interaction never waits on alias, Heichel, comments, translations, or post network work.
- Optional post-ready systems remain optional.
